name: Calculator
description: This project develops a smartphone app for a simple calculator. In its initial version, it allows the user to do basic calculations. More complex calculations will be considered in subsequent versions that are added iteratively.
rawDescription: This project develops a smartphone app for a simple calculator. In its initial version, it allows the user to do basic calculations. More complex calculations will be considered in subsequent versions that are added iteratively.
highLevelGoals: The App User aims to accurately and efficiently execute fundamental arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) using the smartphone application.
lowLevelGoals: The App User inputs the first numerical value into the calculator's display.
The App User selects the addition operator to prepare for an addition calculation.
The App User selects the subtraction operator to prepare for a subtraction calculation.
The App User selects the multiplication operator to prepare for a multiplication calculation.
The App User selects the division operator to prepare for a division calculation.
The App User inputs the second numerical value into the calculator's display.
The App User triggers the calculation to display the result of the selected operation.
The App User clears the current input or result from the calculator's display to start a new entry.

baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The provided high-level goal accurately captures the core functionality of the software as described (basic calculations). There are no contradictions or significant omissions relative to the initial version's scope.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals accurately decompose the high-level goal of performing basic calculations into specific, atomic user actions (inputting operands, selecting operators, executing, and clearing).
